summary: Dashboard: afterApproval() calls render([]) when the last pending brief is approved on the page; render() defaults relayed to [] and replaceChildren() drops the 'Approved through an agent' panel until a reload, so the page stops showing the relayed approvals the moment the human approves the last pending brief. Not covered by briefs-render.test.ts (renders the panel only from a fresh load). The /api/briefs `relayed` list itself is correct (checked through dashboard_briefs.rs).
